title: Consumer Poll, Ack, and Pending
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Consumer Poll, Ack, and Pending.
learning_objectives: Explain consumer poll, ack, and pending using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for consumer poll, ack, and pending

concepts_covered: A consumer cursor is its current reading position; acknowledgement advances it, while pending counts unacknowledged records.
Consumer.Poll and Ack track a single offset for that consumer instance.
